pagerduty-bot: PAGER: High severity: GPU pool infer-west-3 exhausted (100% allocation), request queue length 4200, 5xx rate rising, latency tail > 5s. Paging @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: ack. I'm on it. Starting triage.

maggie: seeing lots of CUDA Xid 31 and OOMs in the driver logs for a subset of nodes. Could be flapping nodes reducing effective capacity.

ryan: confirmed from prometheus: active_gpus = 48 (target 64). node_restarts = 6 in last 10m. autoscaler shows scale_attempts=3 but failed due to "pool_quota_limit".

carla: customer impact: several Prod customers showing increased generation latency and token truncations. Support ticket stream lighting up. Not full outage but large error spike for high-concurrency routes.

infra-bot: autoscaler event: attempt_to_increase_pool(infer-west-3, +16) -> DENIED (quota limit: 64 -> attempted 80).

eng-runtime: log tail from flapping node (gpu-node-17):
```
[2026-03-14T21:03:12Z] nvidia-driver: Xid 31 (unsupported source) detected
[2026-03-14T21:03:13Z] runtime: process oom-killer invoked, kv-cache reset
[2026-03-14T21:03:13Z] kubelet: node status NotReady
```
Looks like repeated driver Xid 31 then OOM cascade causing node to drop from rotation.

sre-oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) remove flapping nodes from pool, 2) apply temporary scale-override to bypass quota if possible, 3) throttle low-priority routes. Which of these we can do now?

ryan: we can cordon/drain the nodes and force-replace, that'll reclaim kube capacity fast. quota override needs ops-manager approval. Throttling can be applied via rate-limiter config, I can push a quick rule to bump low-priority backoffs.

carla: start throttling now, please. Push a fallback for big-team customers to lower batch size to reduce per-request GPU memory. Notify support channels.

ops-manager: I can approve temporary quota bump for 1 hour to allow autoscaler to add +16 GPUs, but need engineering signoff that new nodes won't hit same driver issue.

eng-runtime: agree. We'll disable the new NVF-like kernel path on the rollout candidate and patch the driver on the fly for nodes we add. Also recommend replacing oldest kernel/driver combo on the cluster. If ops-manager approves, we can add with a safer runtime image.

sre-oncall: plan: 1) apply throttles to reduce incoming QPS by 30% for non-SLAs (ryan, do it), 2) cordon + drain nodes [gpu-node-15,16,17] (maggie/ryan), 3) ops-manager to approve quota override so autoscaler can add nodes with patched image (ops-manager), 4) apply runtime patch to new instances (eng-runtime), 5) monitor queue and error rate, escalate to full pager if > 10k queue or 5xx rate persists.

ryan: pushing throttling rule now: route-expr "route in ["non-sla-gen"]" set throttle 0.7 -> :white_check_mark:

maggie: cordon/drain started on gpu-node-15/16/17. Draining logs showing many active sessions; will wait for KV cache flush and migrate.

infra-bot: node gpu-node-16 status: DrainComplete -> evicting pods -> replaced with standby node gpu-node-45 (patched-image).

eng-runtime: new nodes coming up with driver 555.64-patch1 and runtime flags "--disable-nvkernel". We'll watch for Xid recurrence.

sre-oncall: ops-manager approved temporary quota bump +16 for 60m. autoscaler triggered add +16, starting warmup.

ops-manager: FYI I approved but we'll need a postmortem on why quota was hit and why autoscaler couldn't bypass lower thresholds earlier.

carla: support update drafted: "We are experiencing increased latency and intermittent errors due to GPU capacity constraints in west region. We are actively adding capacity and throttling non-SLA traffic. ETA ~30-45m to stabilize." Sending now.

eng-runtime: quick note: the root cause seems to be long-tail KV cache usage + recent kernel driver rollout two days ago. A subset of nodes hits a memory leak under specific seq-len patterns leading to Xid 31 and kernel OOM. We'll include rollback on the kernel path in the postmortem.

sre-oncall: queue length dropping from 4200 -> 1800 after throttles and new nodes joining. 5xx rate down 60%. Latency tail improving but still above SLO.

maggie: drained/cordoned nodes remediated and marked for repro/test. I'll isolate crash dumps and open a runtime issue with traces.

eng-runtime: building a repro job for the driver OOM: run with dense kv-cache and mixed sequence lengths. Linking artifacts to the issue.

sre-oncall: handing off to next oncall in 30m. Current state: partial mitigation successful, new capacity online, throttles in place, flapping nodes isolated, ops-manager temporary quota granted. Customer impact reduced but not fully resolved. Please monitor dashboards and escalate if queue > 3k or 5xx spike > 2x baseline.

ops-manager: noted. Next steps: submit backfill request for permanent quota increase, schedule driver rollback or fixed rollout, and schedule postmortem.

carla: support follow-up: updated customers, asking for any high-priority customers to be routed to backups in other regions.

sre-oncall: thanks team. tagging @eng-runtime and @ops-manager for follow-ups. handing off to @maggie (next oncall) in 30m. :raised_hands:
